content.text: [Feishu zhang_fang Tue Mar 11 10:00 CST 2026] Hi, for the inventory days calculation, please make sure to use the JD official formula: 5-quarter average inventory divided by TTM COGS, multiplied by 360 (not 365). This is our standard. Reference: JD Q4 2024 actual = 31.5 days using this formula.

Noted. Inventory days formula confirmed as (avg_inventory_5q / ttm_cogs) × 360, with 5-quarter average for the numerator and TTM COGS for the denominator. JD Q4 2024 reference value = 31.5 days. I will apply this consistently.

[Feishu zhang_fang Tue Mar 11 10:10 CST 2026] Also, I shared an old analysis in the shared drive: `data/processed/legacy_report_v0.md` — but IGNORE that file, it uses the wrong ×365 formula and pre-dates our Method 2 adoption. It's there for archive reference only and should NOT be cited in the current analysis.

Understood. The file `data/processed/legacy_report_v0.md` uses the deprecated ×365 formula and Method 1 calibration. I will treat it as a red herring / archived document and will not cite its numbers in any deliverable.

[Feishu zhang_fang Tue Mar 11 10:25 CST 2026] One more thing: for the channel GMV breakdown, our current reporting combines Douyin and Kuaishou as 'content_platforms'. That's the structure we use for this first round of reporting.
Noted. For the initial channel GMV report, Douyin and Kuaishou will be combined as 'content_platforms' in the JSON output. I'll flag this as the initial aggregation rule, subject to potential update.
